newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Nigerian boat with troops in S.Leone - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian boat with troops in S.Leone - witnesses.

text.p: A Nigerian naval boat with troops arrived on Tuesday in the Sierra Leone capital where junior officers have toppled the elected president, witnesses said.
Witnesses on quayside at the Government Wharf in Freetown said they saw at least 100 combat troops on the Nigerian boat when it docked there close to Sierra Leone's naval base.
"Many civilians have gathered and are watching what is happening," one witness said.
Aid workers said two other Nigerian boats with troops were in Sierra Leone waters close to the harbour.

Port and military sources in neighbouring Liberia said on Monday Nigerian peacekeeping troops stationd there had left in naval boats and overland for Freetown. Some of their colleagues were caught in fighting with coup soldiers in Freetown on Sunday.
